title: "Arrival of U-2 prototype at Area 51"; "Article 341, the U-2 prototype" (Chapter 2, p. 67)
description: Two black-and-white photographs. The upper one shows the shrouded U-2 prototype being unloaded from a large cargo aircraft, with ground crew nearby; the lower one shows Article 341, the U-2 prototype, on a lakebed with US star insignia on its fuselage. Caption: "Arrival of U-2 prototype at Area 51 (left); Article 341, the U-2 prototype (below)." The text discusses the Pratt & Whitney J57 engines used on early U-2s.
